description: This file defines the interface IBatchContainer within the Orleans.Streams namespace. The interface specifies methods and properties for handling batches of heterogeneous, ordered stream events, including retrieving events, obtaining stream identifiers and sequence tokens, and managing request context data.

classes.name: IBatchContainer
classes.description: An interface for managing batches of stream events, allowing retrieval of events by type, access to stream identifiers and sequence tokens, and request context management.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of events of a specified type from the batch, each paired with a stream sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Allows the batch to modify or set data in the request context before being sent to consumers; returns true if the request context was modified.
